grid.expression: SELECT V.CODPROD, V.DESCRPROD, SUM(V.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, V.PARCEIRO FROM (SELECT SUBSTR(ITE.CODPROD,1,1) || SUBSTR(ITE.CODPROD,3) AS CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, CAB.CODPARC || ' - ' || PAR.NOMEPARC AS PARCEIRO FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') /*AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L'*/ AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND CAB.PENDENTE = 'S' INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND SUBSTR(PRO.CODPROD,1,1) = '3' INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE CAB.DTPREVENT <= :P_DTCORTE GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, CAB.CODPARC || ' - ' || PAR.NOMEPARC ORDER BY ITE.CODPROD) V GROUP BY V.CODPROD, V.DESCRPROD, V.PARCEIRO ORDER BY V.CODPROD
